title: The Harlem Globetrotters
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters 2027 Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their 2027 Rivalry Tour to Springfield, playing the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals, with fans helping decide the action and some getting pulled onto the court. It is aimed at families and all fans, including first-time families, and a free pre-game tip-off party starts when doors open at 6:00 PM. The game is Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
